 branch -->|\"no Credential<br/>no AmbientCaps\"| bad[\"inside: uid=65534 (overflow)<br/>caps stripped at exec<br/>(binary owner host UID 0<br/>is not mapped in user ns)\"]
 bad --> bad_calls[\"sethostname EPERM<br/>mount EPERM<br/>pivot_root EPERM\"]

 branch -->|\"Credential{Uid:0,Gid:0,<br/>NoSetGroups:true}<br/>AmbientCaps[CAP_SYS_ADMIN]\"| good[\"inside: uid=0 (host uid=1000)<br/>CAP_SYS_ADMIN preserved<br/>via ambient set across exec\"]
 good --> good_calls[\"sethostname ok<br/>mount ok<br/>pivot_root ok\"]",
 "config": null
